claim.claim_context: Active atomic proposition I-01 from the frozen ASA 25/261 Premium Grounding claim registry (origin F01/F08; type EXPLICIT; PHYSIOLOGICAL; THERAPEUTIC; PRODUCT-SPECIFIC). Frozen evidence-preparation state: VERY LIMITED DIRECT EVIDENCE. Routing: STANDARD BIOMEDICAL ADJUDICATION
claim.claim_scope: SURROGATE ENDPOINT ONLY | PRODUCT EQUIVALENCE UNCERTAIN | REPLICATION ABSENT for clinical disease
claim.claim_source_reference: INSPEKTORIUM Premium Grounding ASA 25/261 Final Evidence Freeze v1, sections 12/48; evidence cut-off 2026-08-22
claim.intended_reader_or_audience: General consumer audience of a website health advertisement.

contradicting_or_limiting: H34 CRP rests on paired/subgroup analyses without a direct group interaction test
H16 multiplicity across many outcomes and timepoints
H21/H22 are one dataset, not two replications

evidence_items.text: Brown, Chevalier & Hill 2015 and Chevalier et al. 2018 report selected inflammatory and CK-related marker differences across many outcomes and timepoints.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Direct human biomarker signals, but multiply tested and sponsor/network associated.

evidence_items.text: Sokal et al. 2025: CRP 15.34 to 24.42 versus 24.54 to 57.42 mg/L, p=.000033, with sign, mean, median and unit conflicts preserved.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: A large nominal p-value on a surrogate marker in a one-night postoperative setting, with unresolved reporting conflicts.

evidence_items.text: Kim JS et al. 2024: full-sample salivary CRP sneaker 98.74 to 129.11 to 185.15 pg/mL, pre to final p=.046; barefoot 144.80 to 196.94 to 123.67, p=.608. Baseline-CRP at or above 100 post hoc subset: sneaker n=9 p=.963; barefoot n=14 282.13 to 254.26 to 113.11, p=.010.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Earth-contact eligible human CRP line, but these are paired within-group and post hoc subgroup tests; the source table supplies no direct group-by-time or between-group contrast.

evidence_items.text: No clinical inflammatory-disease trial and no validated clinical inflammation endpoint were located.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: The claim names a therapeutic effect for which no clinical outcome study exists.

evidence_items.text: Estiningtyas et al. 2024 reported wound-score improvement in 21 patients with no comparator and incomplete methods.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Uncontrolled; natural course and wound care cannot be separated from the intervention.

evidence.evidence_sufficiency_rationale: All human evidence is surrogate; the claim is therapeutic. No clinical inflammation endpoint was measured anywhere in the located evidence.
supporting: H16/H21 selected inflammatory and CK markers
H34 Earth-contact salivary CRP subgroup signal

detected.rationale: Biomarker-tier evidence (CRP, cytokines, CK, thermography) supports a therapeutic-tier claim about reducing inflammation.
Marker movement in small, multiply tested studies is presented as an established anti-inflammatory effect of the product.

audit_trail: confidence classified as VALID (no coercion to 0.0)
2 failure mode(s) echoed from analysis (not inferred)

reader_impact.likely_reader_misunderstanding: That the product has been shown to reduce clinical inflammation, rather than to move some markers in small studies.
reader_impact.not_a_harm_probability_note: Reader-impact risk is a qualitative category describing how a non-specialist might misread the claim. It is NOT a computed medical, legal, or financial harm probability.
reader_impact.risk_rationale: Readers with inflammatory conditions may substitute the device for treatment; the advertisement pairs the claim with arthritis and other named conditions.

recommended_revision.rewrite_rationale: Out of scope for RUN 001: this run adjudicates the frozen wording only. Replacement claim language occurs downstream after verdict freeze.
recommended_revision.rewrite_verification_note: This rewrite is an UNVERIFIED proposal copied from the analysis input. The numeric-containment guard only checks that it introduces no unsupported number; it does NOT verify factual or semantic accuracy. Its factual support still requires human review.

uncertainty.alternative_label_rationale: Rejected as primary under the frozen precedence rule: the taxonomy explicitly excludes the biomarker/surrogate-to-clinical gap from mechanism_vs_evidence and routes surrogate endpoints framed as clinical outcomes to overclaim.
uncertainty.ambiguity: MATERIAL — Steelman defended a genuine repeated biomarker signal; the adversarial layer showed none of it reaches a clinical endpoint. Resolved as OVERCLAIM with the biomarker signal explicitly preserved.
uncertainty.confidence_caveat: Model's self-assessed probability that its own primary classification is correct (Phase 6.1 semantics). Not a calibrated probability.
missing_evidence: H34 CRP rests on paired/subgroup analyses without a direct group interaction test
H16 multiplicity across many outcomes and timepoints
H21/H22 are one dataset, not two replications
scope_limitations: Adjudication is bounded to the frozen evidence substrate at the 2026-08-22 cut-off. No new literature discovery was performed.
The ASA regulatory outcome is quarantined and contributes no scientific inference.
unresolved_questions: An adequately powered inflammatory-disease or validated-inflammation-endpoint RCT has not been done.

verdict.classification_note: A forensic classification describes the relationship between the claim and the cited evidence. It is not, by itself, proof that the claim is factually false.
verdict.confidence_interpretation: Model's self-assessed probability that its own primary classification is correct (Phase 6.1 semantics). Not a calibrated probability.
verdict.verdict_summary: Human evidence for this claim is entirely surrogate: cytokines, CK, CRP, thermography and one uncontrolled wound series. No clinical inflammatory-disease trial exists, and the newest biomarker line (H34 CRP) rests on paired within-group and post hoc subgroup tests without a direct group contrast.
verdict.verdict_title: Claim goes beyond the available evidence
